displayName: NBD Pro — Rate-limit denial (any; notifies at most every 10 min)

documentation.content:
Rate-limit denials are spiking. Something (an attacker, a bad deploy, a bot, a broken client) is hitting our endpoints far above normal. Check which namespace is being denied (validateAccessCode:ip, publicVisualizerAI:ip, claudeProxy:uid, etc) and correlate to the source IP in Cloud Logging. The namespace is in jsonPayload.namespace.

cspReport:* is excluded (2026-10-15): one browser re-sending CSP reports paged several times a day. cspReport denials log INFO csp_report_rate_limited (sampled once per IP per 10 min, with suppressedSinceLast) instead; look there for CSP-report abuse.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND severity="WARNING" AND jsonPayload.message="rate_limit_denied" AND NOT jsonPayload.namespace=~"^cspReport"
